Light-R1 training data family

dataset.light-r1

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

This existing independently source-qualified family now has separate actual author, source-verifier and adversarial reviews of complete pinned creator-card text and exact substantive provenance, workflow, schema, access/rights declarations and limitations. The inspected README revision is documentation identity, not a verified download/recount or immutable inventory of the dataset payload. Configurations, stages, models and regenerated traces do not add families. No paper/code/media/payload, experimental performance, upstream-rights clearance or operational execution audit is represented. Original unsuccessful hypotheses and real negative reviews remain candidates.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Light-R1 training data family · has stage: Light claims exact- or N-gram-based decontamination and names AIME24/25, MATH-500 and GPQA Diamond as target reasoning benchmarks.

Permanent record ID: candidate.distill5.light.decontamination-procedure-and-warning.v1

  • The same discussion warns that MATH-500 is compromised by identical or numerically altered questions in public data; this is not silently converted into an exact contamination count for Light's released payload.
  • Creator filtering does not establish an independently contamination-free corpus, particularly for upstream pretraining sources.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Light-R1 training data family · has stage: After SFT stage2, Light describes sampling stage2-model responses, separating correct and incorrect outputs, and constructing DPO pairs using verification results and DeepSeek-R1 responses before model merging.

Permanent record ID: candidate.distill5.light.dpo-and-merge-workflow.v1

  • The card describes DPO or NCA with sequence parallelism and a merge of stage2 plus two DPO versions; one DPO-data version skips special tokens in rejected responses.
  • These are creator-described operations, not an inspected payload, executed training recipe or independent human preference-labeling study.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Light-R1 training data family · has stage: Light-R1 describes public math questions with DeepSeek-R1 responses, a 76k first SFT set selected by verification and DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview difficulty sampling, and a harder 3k second set mostly filtered from the first.

Permanent record ID: candidate.distill5.light.math-lineage-and-two-stage-curriculum.v1

  • The model starts from Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct; from scratch is explicitly limited to a model without long chain-of-thought capability, not raw-data pretraining.
  • stage1-76k.json and stage2-3k.json are release descriptions, not independently recounted or proven-disjoint corpora, and remain stages of the existing family.
  • Named question sources include OpenR1-Math, OpenThoughts, LIMO, OpenMathInstruct-2, s1K-1.1, Omni-MATH, hendrycks_math and AIME up to 2023.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

Light-R1 training data family · documents: The Light card reports final AIME24/AIME25 values of 76.6 and 64.6, states 64-run score averaging, and estimates training at under six hours on twelve H800s, around $1,000.

Permanent record ID: candidate.distill5.light.reported-results-estimates-and-domain-limits.v1

  • These are creator-reported scores and cost/time estimates; public-model results may come from existing evaluations, and no experiment, accounting or significance study was reproduced here.
  • A separate stage2-data adaptation statement uses 0.779/0.675 beside 72.6/54.9 for a stated DeepSeek-distill model; its mixed notation is retained rather than substituted for final Light scores.
  • The card describes math-specialized thinking with a forced think marker and some GPQA forgetting; these math results do not independently establish general-domain gains.
